purpose.intro: **What.** The React 19 + TanStack Router web app that mounts module-contributed pages, owns the shell, and renders the product. **How.** Imports each module's public web surface (provider, route contribution, nav contribution, requirements guard, sidebar widgets), wires app-level adapters (router, toast, api client, auth client, query client), and assembles the route tree under one root. **Why.** Modules expose what they DO; the app decides what's MOUNTED, where it sits in the shell, and what the user actually sees. That split is what lets one set of modules serve many products. **This file is the MAP for the web app. Rules live in their owners' docs.**
